mysql.label: MySQL family
mysql.note: Includes MariaDB, TiDB, OceanBase-MySQL and PolarDB-MySQL, detected automatically on connect

postgres.label: PostgreSQL family
postgres.note: Includes KingbaseES, openGauss/GaussDB and HighGo, detected automatically on connect

dameng.label: DM (Dameng)
dameng.note: Requires the DM DPI client library

sqlserver.label: SQL Server
sqlserver.note: SQL logins and Windows authentication; browse by database after connecting

tidb.label: TiDB
tidb.note: Default port 4000; no stored procedures or triggers

oceanbase.label: OceanBase
oceanbase.note: MySQL mode; user name is user@tenant (e.g. root@sys); through OBProxy the port is usually 2883

kingbase.label: KingbaseES
kingbase.note: Default port 54321; Oracle and PG compatibility modes are detected on connect

opengauss.label: openGauss
opengauss.note: SHA256 authentication supported; A (Oracle) and PG compatibility are detected per database

gaussdb.label: GaussDB
gaussdb.note: Default port 8000; uses the PG protocol. Tested on the developer edition, not the cloud service. The initial user cannot connect remotely, so create another user

dameng.label: Dameng DM
dameng.note: Requires the Dameng DPI client library

sqlserver.label: SQL Server
sqlserver.note: Default port 1433; set a named instance under Advanced to look up the port through SQL Browser

validate.serviceOrSidRequired: Enter a service name or SID
validate.timeoutRange: Timeout must be between 1 and 600 seconds

dialog.modeOracle: Compatibility mode: {{mode}} (Oracle rules: empty string is NULL, DATE has a time)
dialog.modeUnadapted: Compatibility mode {{mode}} is not supported yet; native rules are used and some features may fail
dialog.productMismatch: {{chosen}} was selected but the server is {{detected}}; DBLens follows the detected server

general.name: Name
general.passwordKeepPlaceholder: Leave blank to keep the saved password (re-enter it to test the connection)
general.oracleServicePlaceholder: FREEPDB1; to connect by SID, set it under Advanced
general.prodHint: Production connection: tabs are marked red; UPDATE/DELETE without WHERE, DROP and TRUNCATE require confirmation

tls.caPlaceholder: Optional: additional trusted CA certificate file (absolute path)
tls.unsupported: TLS cannot be configured here for {{driver}} yet

advanced.sidPlaceholder: If set, connect by SID and ignore the service name
advanced.colorPlaceholder: Optional, overrides the environment color, e.g. #d4380d

vault.introInit: No system keychain is available on this computer, so connection passwords are encrypted with a master password and stored locally. A forgotten master password cannot be recovered; you would have to re-enter each connection's password.
vault.introUnlock: Connection passwords are stored in a local encrypted vault. Enter the master password to unlock it.

sqlserver.windowsHint: Write the user name as DOMAIN-or-HOST\user (NTLM); available on Windows only
sqlserver.integratedHint: Logs in as the Windows account running the DBLens service, without a user name or password; in browser mode that is the server's account, not the browser machine's. Available on Windows only
sqlserver.instancePlaceholder: Optional, e.g. SQLEXPRESS; the port is ignored when set
sqlserver.trustCertHint: Trust the server certificate (no validation, like the SSMS option)
